note: The def_path multiset behind the gated `interpreter_agreed`, `seam_agreed` and `flip_backed` counts. Diagnostic, not a gate: on a red the ratchet names the bodies that were lost instead of only the delta. def_path is not injective over bodies (closures and promoted constants share names), so this is compared as a MULTISET. A channel is rewritten only when its scalar axis was seeded or raised.
